data.narrative:
ispace is a publicly listed Space & Aerospace company founded by Takeshi Hakamada, having raised $200M+ in prior private rounds. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 4 same-sector, same-stage public comparables: Rocket Lab ($40.0B), Planet Labs ($7.6B), Firefly Aerospace ($2.9B), and Astroscale ($840M).

The peer-median method is applicable and yields a central valuation estimate. The median valuation across the four public Space & Aerospace comparables is $5.2B, with a range spanning $840M at the low end and $40.0B at the high end. A revenue-based P/S triangulation method was not feasible because ispace's revenue figures are not on file. The public Space & Aerospace sector trades at a median P/S multiple of 27.4x across 6 listed tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL); however, without disclosed revenue, this multiple cannot be applied.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $4.4B (low) to $6.0B (high), centered on $5.2B. Key uncertainties include ispace's revenue trajectory relative to peers—which would anchor a P/S-based valuation—and the substantial variance within the comp set ($840M to $40.0B), reflecting disparate business models and maturity stages within commercial spaceflight. The median estimate should be stress-tested against ispace's operational milestones and comparative market position within lunar logistics.
